general.name: Ashvale General Store
general.greet: Bread, potions and good honest tools. What'll it be?

tailor.name: Wren's Tailoring
tailor.greet: Hats, capes and robes, stitched this week. Right-click to trade.

armoury.name: Garrick's Armoury
armoury.greet: Bronze, iron and steel, all forged right here. Mithril and adamant? Only the valley's monsters carry those.

tavern.name: The Saltmere Tap
tavern.greet: Sit where you like. The fish came in this morning, the bread yesterday.

fish.name: Nettie's Fish
fish.greet: Fresh off the water this morning. What have you got?

chandler.name: Sela's Chandlery
chandler.greet: Line, hooks and pots, and anything you drag back off the shore.

salt_general.name: Saltmere General Store
salt_general.greet: Everything a ship needs and most of what a traveller needs. The land route is dearer, so I am cheaper.

salt_armoury.name: Saltmere Armoury
salt_armoury.greet: Steel as standard, mithril if you can pay for it. Saltmere arms its own before it arms anyone else.

castle_kitchen.name: The Castle Kitchens
castle_kitchen.greet: The range is hot and the bread is from this morning. Cook your own if you like; the range is for everyone.

castle_general.name: Castle Stores
castle_general.greet: Rope, nets, tinderboxes, bread. If the castle needs it, I count it, and I sell what I can spare.

castle_armoury.name: The Castle Armoury
castle_armoury.greet: Steel for the watch, and for you if you can pay. The good bows go up the wall first.

salt_magic.name: Saltmere Enchantery
salt_magic.greet: It does the same damage as the plain staff and a little less. What it does is hold the thing you hit.

data.note: prices are item.value GOLD; a shop buys at buyRate percent the items whose category (or category/subcategory) is in buys ('any' = everything but currency). Shop keeper = an NPC id in a zone module.
